name: ETF expense compare
pitch: Compare zero-commission ETFs' expense ratios and bid-ask spreads across three brokers.
instructions: Search for zero-commission ETFs from three chosen brokers. For each broker, collect the expense ratio and the bid-ask spread for the same ETF ticker. If a broker does not list the ticker, note that it is not available. Present the data in a table with columns: Broker, Ticker, Expense Ratio, Bid-Ask Spread. If any data cannot be found, say so plainly and do not invent numbers. At the end, show the table and list any missing information.

examples.does: search each broker and list the expense ratios and spreads

readme:
# ETF expense compare
Compare zero-commission ETFs' expense ratios and bid-ask spreads across three brokers.

What it does: searches the web for cost data from up to three brokers and presents it side by side.
What it needs: web search, a comparison table tool, and the ability to write a short text file.
What it will not do: it cannot give financial advice, it cannot check real-time prices after the search, and it cannot open accounts or make trades.
